instructions.name: unused
instructions.title: Unused (deprecated RequestUnits)
instructions.rationale: Deprecated reserved tag 0 (formerly RequestUnits with a flat lamport fee); the runtime now rejects it, so deny by default.
instructions.notes: Name is the interface crate's (solana-compute-budget-interface v3.1.0: `Unused`, "deprecated variant, reserved value"). Through agave v1.17.34 this tag was RequestUnitsDeprecated { units: u32, additional_fee: u32 } (9 bytes: tag, units u32le at offset 1, additional_fee u32le at offset 5; additional_fee was a flat lamport priority fee); the Codama IDL still names it requestUnits. Feature remove_deprecated_request_unit_ix (EfhYd3SafzGT472tYQDUc4dPd2xdEfKs5fwkowUgVt4W) is active on mainnet-beta (activated_at slot 233280000) and devnet (slot 242352004) (feature account read via getAccountInfo, 2026-10-10), so a transaction containing tag 0 now fails with InvalidInstructionData (agave v4.3.0 process_instruction catch-all). amount is null on purpose: the legacy fee field is no longer honored.

instructions.name: request_heap_frame
instructions.title: Request heap frame
instructions.rationale: Requests a larger transaction-wide program heap; moves no funds and changes no account state.
instructions.notes: Wire data is 5 bytes: [01][bytes u32le]. Shorter than 8 bytes, so disc8 is the tag zero-padded, never raw bytes. Runtime requires a multiple of 1024 between 32768 (32 KiB) and 262144 (256 KiB), else InvalidInstructionData; at most one per transaction (DuplicateInstruction). Top-level only: the budget is read from the transaction's instruction list before execution and the program entrypoint is a no-op, so a CPI has no effect (inferred from agave v4.3.0 source).

instructions.name: set_compute_unit_limit
instructions.title: Set compute unit limit
instructions.rationale: Caps the compute units the transaction may use; affects fees and scheduling only, moves no funds.
instructions.notes: Wire data is 5 bytes: [02][units u32le]. disc8 is the tag zero-padded. Effective limit is clamped to 1,400,000 CUs; priority fee = ceil(limit * price / 1,000,000) lamports, so this value scales the cost of SetComputeUnitPrice. At most one per transaction. Top-level only (a CPI has no effect; inferred from agave v4.3.0 source). Ignored in v1-format transactions per the solana.com compute-budget docs.

instructions.name: set_compute_unit_price
instructions.title: Set compute unit price
instructions.rationale: Sets the priority-fee price in micro-lamports per compute unit; moves no tokens but raises the fee payer's SOL cost.
instructions.notes: Wire data is 9 bytes: [03][micro_lamports u64le]; the raw first 8 bytes would include 7 price bytes, so disc8 is the tag zero-padded. Runtime accepts any u64. The fee payer pays ceil(price * compute_unit_limit / 1,000,000) lamports (limit at most 1,400,000), so an unbounded price can burn the payer's SOL: cap `amount` when the mandate owner pays fees. Kept read_only per SCHEMA.md (compute budget) because no tokens move. At most one per transaction. Top-level only (a CPI has no effect; inferred from agave v4.3.0 source). Ignored in v1-format transactions per the solana.com compute-budget docs.

instructions.name: set_loaded_accounts_data_size_limit
instructions.title: Set loaded accounts data size limit
instructions.rationale: Caps the total account data the transaction may load; moves no funds and changes no account state.
instructions.notes: Wire data is 5 bytes: [04][bytes u32le]. disc8 is the tag zero-padded. Value must be non-zero (0 gives InvalidLoadedAccountsDataSizeLimit); effective limit is clamped to 64 MiB (67,108,864). At most one per transaction. Top-level only (a CPI has no effect; inferred from agave v4.3.0 source).
